name: Robot Path
description: Program a toy robot with cards to collect gems. The ladder runs from arrow cards to repeats, ifs, whiles, a stamp, variables, debugging and one program for three mazes.

about.concept: Sequencing and abstraction, the foundations of programming. Arrow cards move a robot; the child plans the whole path before running it, then shortens it with repeats and conditions.
about.progression: Arrow cards on small boards lead to rocky boards, a Repeat card with a card limit, an If pink card and fewest moves puzzles. Then forward and turn cards bring a Repeat inside a Repeat, a Stamp the child defines once and uses twice, a board number n, If wall with else, While gems left, fixing a program with one wrong card, fewest cards for extra stars, one program that solves three mazes by the right hand rule, and numbered gems collected in order.
